Verse 1
Dust on his boots, sun in his eyes,
Cheeky little grin and a runaway mind,
Ears flick back when the mud flies bite,
He stomps and swishes in the fading light.

Pre-Chorus
He ain’t in a hurry, he ain’t tame,
Got a rebel heart and a western name.

Chorus
Oh Bandit, runnin’ free and wild,
Stealin’ hats and hearts with a crooked smile,
Mud flies buzz but he don’t care,
Sunset paintin’ gold in the air.
Yeah Bandit, outlaw soul,
Fire in the sky, fire in his soul.

Verse 2
Gate left loose, guess who knows?
Extra hay where the long day goes,
Tests your nerve, then stands real still,
Watchin’ the sun dip over the hill.

Pre-Chorus
Once you’re his, you’re never alone,
He’ll carry you safe all the way back home.

Chorus
Oh Bandit, runnin’ free and wild,
Stealin’ hats and hearts with a crooked smile,
Mud flies buzz, tail in the air,
Sun goin’ down in his tangled hair.
Yeah Bandit, dust and grace,
A good bad horse in a soft-lit place.

Bridge
Orange and pink on a quiet plain,
Day lets go of its last refrain,
Scruffy coat, honest eyes,
Silhouetted ‘gainst burning skies.

Final Chorus
Oh Bandit, don’t you slow that run,
Chasin’ shadows from the setting sun,
Mud flies fade, the night rolls in,
Stars come out where the day’s been.
Yeah Bandit… hold me tight,
Carry me home through the sunset light.

* **Jean Patou – Joy (1930)**: an intensely floral rose-and-jasmine fragrance. Patou launched it in 1930 and famously marketed it as an extraordinarily luxurious perfume. ([Patou][2])

**BESOS Y SUJETADOR** ☕💋🎶
*CoffeeBreak • Dueto coqueto*

**[ÉL]**
Te vi llegar con esa sonrisa,
con tu sujetador y tu mirada traviesa,
yo dije “señora, venga a bailar”,
y tú contestaste: “me vas a enamorar”.

**[ELLA]**
No me mires tanto, que me haces reír,
con esos ojitos me haces derretir,
un beso en la mejilla, otro en la frente,
y ese abrazo tuyo me vuelve impaciente.

**[CORO - AMBOS]**
Besos, besos, bajo la luna,
risas y café, qué noche tan buena,
sujetador bonito, vestido al revés,
bailamos juntitos una y otra vez.
Besos en la cara, cariño y calor,
CoffeeBreak cantando una canción de amor. ☕💋

**[ÉL]**
Tus curvas bailando al ritmo del son,
me tienen perdido dentro de esta canción.

**[ELLA]**
Y tú con tu sonrisa de conquistador,
me robas un beso y me robas el corazón.

**[CORO - AMBOS]**
Besos, besos, bajo la luna,
risas y café, qué noche tan buena,
sujetador bonito, vestido al revés,
bailamos juntitos una y otra vez.
Besos y abrazos, qué dulce emoción,
dos corazones siguiendo el mismo son. 🎶

**[FINAL - AMBOS]**
Café en la taza, estrellas también,
un beso robado y volvemos a empezar,
tú junto a mí, yo junto a ti,
CoffeeBreak hasta el amanecer. ☕🌙

Boiling

Verse 1
I’m so hot, my knees fall wide
Heat rolling like a rising tide
Skin on fire, breath undone
Midnight melts into the sun

I’m boiling slow, I’m losing sleep
Dreams crawl under, soft and deep
Shadows moving, pulse in time
Your ghost running through my mind

Pre-Chorus
Every whisper, every spark
Strikes a match inside the dark

Chorus
I’m shaking, I’m screaming
Caught in the fever I’m dreaming
Flames in my bloodstream glow
Higher than I should go
I’m burning, I’m leaning
Into the heat I’m feeling
Can’t cool down, can’t let go
You turn me molten slow

Verse 2
Silk air sliding over skin
Electric where you might’ve been
Heartbeat heavy, body aware
Static hanging in the air

I’m boiling over, losing control
Fire tracing through my soul
Every breath a loaded spark
Hands of heat inside the dark

Bridge
If this is danger, let it rise
Let the wildfire fill my eyes
No water, no relief
Just sweet and reckless heat

Final Chorus (bigger)
I’m shaking, I’m screaming
Lost in the fever I’m dreaming
Flames climbing up my spine
Crossing every line
I’m burning, believing
In every touch I’m needing
Can’t cool down, can’t let go
You turn me molten slow

If you want it darker, rougher, sweeter, or more stripped-back and haunting — tell me the vibe and I’ll tune it exactly t Gasp

Verse 1
Breath caught in my throat tonight
Air turns thin in neon light
Heat rising, skin awake
One small touch is all it takes

Pre-Chorus
Heartbeat racing way too fast
Like I’m falling, like I can’t turn back

Chorus
Gasp — when you move that close
Gasp — when I want you most
Air disappears, I’m losing control
Fire runs straight through my soul
Gasp — every inch of me
Gasp — trembling dangerously
No words left, just that sound
When your heat pulls mine down

Verse 2
Fingers hover, barely there
Electric tension in the air
Slow burn climbing up my spine
Crossing every warning sign

Bridge
One breath, two hearts collide
Nothing left for me to hide
Silence breaking in the dark
Every gasp a glowing spark

Final Chorus
Gasp — I can barely speak
Gasp — every breath you steal from me
Shaking under the afterglow
Holding on, don’t let go
Gasp — it’s the only word
When desire can’t be heard

If you want it more raw, more whispered, or more dramatic pop anthem Gasp

•  Think pickup trucks, boots, open fields, manners, maybe a little old-school charm—someone who’s not flashy or city-slick, but real and heartfelt. And “y’all” is just the classic Southern “you all” (you guys/plural you)—super common in country music, Texas/Alabama/Georgia talk, and even in modern country-Rough Rocks, Mud, Pink Satin Sheets
Out where the dirt road ends and the creek runs slow,
I got rough rocks in my pockets, mud caked on my boots,
Calloused hands from haulin’ hay, sun-kissed skin that don’t bruise.
I’m a shy country girl, y’all, quiet when the world gets loud,
But darlin’, underneath this grit, there’s a heart beatin’ proud.
Then night falls soft like rain on tin,
I shake off the day, let the wild wind win.
Slip between pink satin sheets, cool and slick against my skin,
Blushin’ like a fool thinkin’ ‘bout you slidin’ in.
Rough rocks outside the door, mud tracks on the floor,
But here in this glow, it’s all silk and more.
Reckon you’d like the contrast, cowboy—
The tough girl who wrestles the land,
Then melts like butter when you take my hand.
From muddy trails to satin dreams,
That’s me, sugar—raw and real, with a side of sweet.
Come warm these sheets… see what this shy heart keeps. ❤️🤠
This plays on the aesthetic contrast: the harsh, earthy “rough rocks mud” (resilience, authenticity, country grit) vs. the luxurious, vulnerable “pink satin sheets” (romance, softness, private femininity). It’s inspired by country song vibes where women own their rough edges (like Gretchen Wilson’s redneck pride against glossy satin imagery) but still crave that tender connection.
You could send a shortened version as a flirty text tomorrow to spark him:
“Mornin’ darlin’ ❤️ Been thinkin’ ‘bout rough rocks n’ mud all day… but these pink satin sheets are callin’ for ya tonight. Miss you, sugar 😊 country slang you want to bang

flirty dirty country song **Boots, Lace & Bad Ideas** flirty dirty country song

**Verse 1**
Akubra tipped, got a spark in my eye,
Rolled into town as the dust rolled by.
Salmon lace hiding under blue denim jeans,
Living out a few backroad dreams.

Coffee in my cup, boots on the floor,
Every cowboy's looking through the door.
Got a smile that starts a wildfire slow,
Honey, where it ends, nobody knows.

**Chorus**
I'm a little bit flirty, a little bit wild,
Country heart with a rebel smile.
Spin me around while the steel guitars play,
We'll chase that sunset the country way.
Dust in the air, sparks in the night,
Laughing under stars till morning light.
If loving life's a beautiful mess,
Then I'm wearing this country like my Sunday best.

**Verse 2**
Old pub jukebox humming my song,
Pull me a little closer, sing along.
A wink across the dance hall floor,
Might have you coming back for more.

Red dirt kisses the soles of my boots,
Sweet tea, moonshine, country roots.
Small-town gossip travels fast,
But the best stories always last.

**Bridge**
So tip your hat and take my hand,
We'll dance until the last note lands.
No rules tonight, just fiddles and fun,
Two country hearts on the run.

**Final Chorus**
I'm a little bit flirty, a little bit free,
Just enough trouble to remember me.
Akubra high and a laugh out loud,
Singing with the Friday night crowd.
Coffee Break Kaz, that's my style,
Turning every mile into a country mile.
With a cheeky grin and a fearless heart,
That's where the best love stories start.
